Craft Design System

Live Site GitHub

A zero-dependency design token and multi-brand component library architecture designed for scalable enterprise web platforms.

Overview

Craft Design System is an architectural experiment in building ultra-fast, accessible, theme-driven components with zero runtime CSS overhead.

Key Highlights

  • Design Tokens: Standardized JSON tokens compiled automatically into CSS custom properties and Tailwind utility classes.
  • Accessibility: 100% WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with automated axe-core audits.
  • Performance: Zero-runtime CSS injection resulting in sub-5ms rendering overhead.

Antigravity Dev Engine

Live Site GitHub

A lightweight, privacy-focused dashboard providing high-frequency latency and render performance insights for web developers.

Overview

Antigravity Dev Engine processes real-time browser performance metrics directly on the edge, providing immediate feedback on Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) and Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).

Features

  • Real-Time Instrumentation: Native PerformanceObserver API integration.
  • Edge Analytics: Lightweight WebWorker pipeline processing metric data without blocking the main event loop.
